items.title: Clocks Spring Forward One Hour Tonight
items.card_text: Clocks Spring Forward One Hour Tonight Invercargill loses an hour of sleep tonight. Clocks spring forward at 2am Sunday, September 27, jumping straight to 3am — and no, you don't get it back until April 4. Daylight saving has been New Zealand's twice-yearly ritual since 1927, when entomologist George Hudson lobbied to What's On Invers Yesterday Culture
